cards.title: Tabby franchise stock-out
cards.ask_prefill: Why is Tabby flagged in week 29?

chart.unit: weeks of supply

cards.headline: Tabby has 2.1 weeks of supply and Pillow Tabby 1.8, while replenishment covered only 28% of what Tabby sold.
cards.body: Last year the same week held 7.0 and 5.1 weeks, and Tabby receipts covered 95% of sales. At this pace Tabby runs out in about 2.6 weeks and Pillow Tabby in 2.2, putting $23.1K of sample demand at risk (7.7% of the next four weeks). Re-open replenishment on both now (R1).

cards.title: Retention leak and Insider gap
cards.ask_prefill: Why is retention flagged in week 29?

chart.unit: Insider attach of new customers (TY)

cards.headline: Only 16.4% of new Gen Z joined Insider over L4W, the gap behind a flat returning base.
cards.body: Period-to-date returning customers are 1,142 vs 1,142 and returning Gen Z is -6.5%, even though L4W improved (+3.8%). The gap is widest in Outlet (9.7% vs 23.1% for other new customers) and Greater China (5.1% vs 21.7%). Enrol at the first Gen Z purchase: +10% returning Gen Z is worth about 0.85% of demand (R3).
